basic_info.description: 1 bedroom Below Market Rate (BMR) housing opportunity available at 100% Area Median Income (AMI). Maximum income for 1 person = $109,100; 2 = $124,700; 3 = $140,250; 4 = $155,850; 5 = $168,300, etc. Must be 1st-time homebuyer & income eligible. Unit available thru the Mayor's Office of Housing and Community Development (MOHCD) & subject to resale controls, monitoring & other restrictions. Unit will be listed on DAHLIA, the SF Housing Portal (https://housing.sfgov.org) starting on the application date 6-24-2025. Visit https://housing.sfgov.org for application & program info. Application, loan pre-approval, and homebuyer education verification due on 7-15-2025 at 5:00 PM. Fair Housing Opportunity.
